chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام that he said:

Five people do not lead the people, and they do not perform with them an obligatory prayer in congregation: the leper, the one afflicted with al-judham, the child of zina, the Bedouin until he migrates, and the one subjected to the legal punishment.

key_terms.الْأَعْرَابِيُّ: a Bedouin Arab, here until migration
key_terms.الْمَحْدُودُ: one upon whom a legal punishment has been carried out
key_terms.يَؤُمُّونَ: to lead others in prayer as Imam

ai.seo_question: Who is not permitted to lead the obligatory congregational prayer according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding who should not serve as Imam for an obligatory congregational prayer. It identifies five categories of people who are not to lead the community in such worship, reflecting jurisprudential conditions related to congregational salat leadership.
